---
name: Dataset review
about: Verify a dataset before we use it
labels: data
---

**Dataset** (name as in resources/datasets/README.md)

- [ ] Link checked
- [ ] License verified (write it in the catalogue; never leave "to verify")
- [ ] Size recorded
- [ ] Card written in resources/datasets/cards/, including "What this does not cover"
- [ ] Used for: evidence or build
- [ ] If synthetic: every file labelled synthetic

**Notes**
